Chronic autoimmune cutaneous lupus; Raynaud phenomenon alone does not establish vascular damage. Systemic lupus is occasional and separate.
Mesoaxial polydactyly and congenital cardiac malformations define the syndrome; intellectual disability has no documented frequency.
COFS defines cerebral, ocular and skeletal abnormalities; hearing impairment in 1/1 reported patient. Cutaneous findings omitted at the four-axis cap.
Ependymal tumor arising in the central nervous system.
Congenital absence of one lower limb.
Hip epiphyseal abnormalities and cartilaginous bone lesions define the disease.
Dermatophyte infection of beard hair follicles and adjacent skin.
Inherited Parkinson disease with bradykinesia, rigidity, tremor and postural instability.
Familial partial paralysis suggests neurologic loss of motor function; no definition or phenotypes establish a specific muscle or metabolic disorder.
Residual glaucomatous damage affects the eye and optic nerve.
Established corticosteroid-induced glaucoma is itself an ocular disease; no additional organ involvement is established.
Microphthalmia with blindness and microcephaly defines ocular and cerebral developmental abnormalities.
Skeletal dysplasia, developmental impairment and acanthosis define SADDAN; hearing loss 1/3. Cardiac findings in 1/3 lack clear direct attribution.
Lysosomal storage with progressive CNS dysfunction; skeletal dysplasia is common, with scoliosis/platyspondyly in 1/1 annotated patient. Ocular frequency unclear.
Bacterial infection directly inflames and damages myocardium.
GnRH deficiency defines endocrine disease; olfactory developmental dysfunction is a defining Kallmann feature, with hyposmia 2/4 and anosmia 1/4.
GM2 storage causes neurodegeneration; retinal ganglion-cell degeneration and progressive visual loss are common (>30%). Hepatosplenomegaly only 5-29%.
Umbrella for inherited carbohydrate metabolic defects; no additional organ damage is shared across most subtypes.

Congenital acral skin hyperpigmentation.
Benign adipose tumor located in the conjunctiva.
IL6R deficiency defines an inherited immunodeficiency; supplied evidence does not establish common direct damage to another organ.
